events.title: Anatolaks
events.description: Anatolaks is a music band based in Oslo, mainly covering songs in the genres of Turkish-Anatolian and Psychedelic Rock (a fusion of Turkish folk music and rock). The band was founded in 2024 by Arda Unlusoy (drums, back vocal), Burak Kara (vocal, electric guitar), Yavuzer Cetin (electric guitar) and Numan Hekimoglu (bass guitar). Emre Onder Guner (baglama/saz) and Ahmet Emin Memis (darbuka and ney) joined later and completed the band's final lineup. Each member is an experienced musician who has previously performed at various well-known events in Turkiye. These six individuals, each with different backgrounds, came together in Oslo and now share a common goal: to carry the distinctive sound of Anatolia beyond borders!

events.title: MACY GRAY - THE TROUBLE WITH THE TRUTH TOUR
events.description: On November 15, 2026, one of modern soul's most distinctive voices takes the stage at Røkeriet. With her raspy, unmistakable vocals, funky energy, and uncompromising approach to soul, Macy Gray has been in a league of her own ever since her breakthrough in the late '90s. Her music is direct, honest, and full of personality -- with songs that hit just as hard on the dance floor as they do in the heart. Gray achieved her international breakthrough in 1999 with her triple-platinum debut album On How Life Is. The album featured the global hit "I Try," which earned her a Grammy Award for Best Female Pop Vocal Performance. Since then, she has sold more than 25 million albums, received five Grammy nominations and two BRIT Awards, and built a devoted fan base around the world. Throughout her career, she has collaborated with artists including Ariana Grande, Bobby Brown, and Galactic, while cementing her reputation as a formidable live performer. On stage, she blends soul, R&B, and funk with raw presence, humor, and a voice you recognize from the very first note. In addition to her music career, Macy Gray has also made her mark as an actress, appearing in films and TV series including Training Day, For Colored Girls, and Fuller House.
